academic_translation:
Those who have become vessels for the vast Dharma
Should not be engaged in the lesser Dharma;
Conduct should not be completely forsaken,
Nor should one lure them with sūtras and mantras.
translation: People who are ready for the vast teachings should not practice the lesser teachings instead. Good behavior should not be given up completely. I should not lure people away with teaching texts and sacred words.

academic_translation:
In vehicles, on beds, seats, and in dwellings,
One should not be alone with another woman.
Having observed and inquired, one should avoid
Everything that causes the world to lose faith.
translation: I should not be alone with another woman in a vehicle, on a bed, on a seat, or in a room. By watching and asking, I should find out what makes the world lose faith. Then I must avoid all of it.

academic_translation:
Whether directly or indirectly,
Do nothing other than the benefit of sentient beings;
For the sake of sentient beings alone,
Make a dedication of everything for awakening.
translation: Whether directly or indirectly, I should only do things that help living beings. For the sake of living beings alone, I should give everything to awakening by sharing the goodness.

academic_translation:
From the liberation story of Śrīsaṃbhava,
One should train in the manner of relying on the teacher;
This and other words spoken by the Buddha
Should be known by reading the sūtras.
translation: I should learn how to rely on a teacher from the life story of Shrisambhava. I should read the scriptures to learn this and other things the Buddha taught.

academic_translation:
The enemy, anger, produces
These and other such sufferings.
Whoever strives to destroy anger
Is happy in this life and the next.
translation: Anger is an enemy, and it brings these and other kinds of suffering. Whoever tries hard to destroy anger will be happy in this life and the next.

academic_translation:
Snakes and gadflies,
Feelings of hunger, thirst, and so forth,
And afflictions such as rashes—
Why do you not see their pointless suffering?
translation: Think of snakes, biting flies, itchy rashes, and the feeling of hunger and thirst. The suffering they bring is pointless. Why do you not see this?

academic_translation:
Even when suffering arises, the wise
Should not cloud the clarity of the mind,
For in waging war against the afflictions,
Harms are many during the battle.
translation: Even when suffering happens, wise people keep a clear mind. This is because they are fighting a war against troubling emotions, and many harms happen during a battle.

academic_translation:
Furthermore, the good quality of suffering is:
Through disillusionment, haughtiness is dispelled,
Compassion arises for those in saṃsāra,
One shuns misdeeds and delights in virtue.
translation: Suffering also has a good quality. Getting tired of suffering stops us from feeling superior. We feel compassion for those in the cycle of rebirth. We avoid harmful deeds and enjoy good deeds.

academic_translation:
Thus, everything is under the power of others,
And through that power, it is powerless.
Knowing this, one will not become angry
At any entities, which are like emanations.
translation: Everything is controlled by other forces. Because of this power, everything is powerless. Knowing this, a person will not get angry at any things. They are like things that magic has conjured up.

academic_translation:
If you object, "By what is what to be prevented?
Even preventing is unreasonable!"
In dependence upon that, it is not unreasonable
To wish for sufferings to be severed.
translation: Someone might ask, "What can stop what? Even stopping things makes no sense!" But because suffering depends on its causes, it does make sense. It is not wrong to wish for suffering to be cut away.

academic_translation:
Therefore, whether it is an enemy or a friend,
If you see them doing what is improper,
Thinking, "This has arisen from such conditions,"
Reflect in this way and remain at ease.
translation: Therefore, if you see an enemy or a friend doing something wrong, think, "This has come from these circumstances." Think this way and stay at ease.

academic_translation:
Having employed sticks and the like as the actual instruments,
if one feels anger at the one who throws them,
since he too is driven by hatred,
then, in the second place, it is fitting to feel anger at hatred.
translation: Someone might hit me with a stick. If I feel anger at the person swinging it, since he is driven by hatred too, it makes more sense to feel anger at hatred.

academic_translation:
If I possess the intention's
Good quality, I will not go to hell;
If I protect myself,
What will happen to them here?
translation: If my intention has a good quality, I will not go to hell. If I protect myself, what will happen to them here?

academic_translation:
Likewise, whatever the mind has attachment to,
In which the fire of hatred has spread,
Out of fear that merit will be burned,
That must be discarded instantly.
translation: In the same way, the fire of hatred spreads to whatever the mind is clinging to. To stop my store of goodness from burning, I must throw away right now whatever my mind is clinging to.

academic_translation:
For the misdeeds you yourself have committed,
Not only are you without sorrow,
But with others who have performed merit,
Do you wish to compete?

The Second Fascicle.
translation: You feel no sorrow for the harmful deeds you yourself have done. On top of that, do you want to compete with others who have built up a store of goodness? This is the end of the second part of the book.

academic_translation:
If I were to know my own welfare,
What welfare of mine is there in that?
If I desire only mental happiness,
I must also rely on gambling, alcohol, and the like.
translation: Even if I knew my own good, what own good is there in that? If I only want my mind to feel happy, I would also have to turn to gambling, alcohol, and things like that.

academic_translation:
Therefore, those who are present
In order to destroy my praise and so forth—
Are they not engaged in protecting me
From falling into the lower realms?
translation: Therefore, some people are around to destroy my praise and things like it. Are they not protecting me from falling into an unhappy realm?

academic_translation:
If, due to my own faults,
I do not practice patience toward this,
When the cause of merit is present,
I am merely creating an obstacle to it.

locked_terms.use: cause of a store of goodness

translation: If my own faults stop me from practicing patience with this, I am only making a block, even when the cause of a store of goodness is right in front of me.

academic_translation:
By a beggar who arrives at the right time,
No obstacle to generosity is made;
One who grants ordination
Cannot be called an obstacle to ordination.
translation: A beggar who arrives at the right time is not a block to giving. Someone who gives you the vows of a monk or nun cannot be called a block to becoming a monk or nun.

academic_translation:
Therefore, since patience arises
In dependence on a very hateful mind,
Since they are the very cause of patience,
They are worthy of veneration like the sublime Dharma.
translation: Therefore, patience arises by depending on someone's very hateful mind. Since they are the exact cause of patience, they deserve to be honored just like the holy teachings.

academic_translation:
Because they have a share in accomplishing the qualities of a Buddha,
Therefore sentient beings and the Buddhas are held to be equal.
Yet to those with an infinite ocean of good qualities,
To the Buddhas, no one is equal.
translation: Living beings have a share in bringing about the qualities of a Buddha. Because of this, living beings and the Buddhas are seen as equal. But no one is truly equal to the Buddhas. They have an endless ocean of good qualities.

academic_translation:
Of the unique collection of supreme good qualities,
If merely a fraction of those good qualities
Appears in someone, in order to make offerings to them,
Even offering the three realms would be too little.
translation: If even a tiny part of that special collection of supreme good qualities appears in someone, I should make offerings to them. Even giving them the three realms would be too little.

academic_translation:
Furthermore, to those who become friends without deceit
And who perform immeasurable benefit,
Other than pleasing sentient beings,
By what else could they be repaid?
translation: There are true friends who never trick me and who help me in ways I cannot measure. How could I ever pay them back? The only way is by making living beings happy.

academic_translation:
"This is not done, this is just begun,
And this remains only half-done"—
When the Lord of Death suddenly arrives,
I will think, "Alas, I am destroyed!"
translation: When the Lord of Death suddenly arrives, I will find that "This is not done. That is just begun. This is only half done." Then I will think, "Oh no, I am ruined!"

academic_translation:
If you, like a live fish writhing about,
Are possessed by fear in this life,
Having committed misdeeds, what need is there to mention
The unbearable sufferings of hell?
translation: In this life, you flip around in fear like a live fish. Since you have done harmful deeds, there is no need to even mention the unbearable sufferings of hell!
